---
title: "Revenue by channel"
jupyter: php
---

```{php}
#| echo: false
use function Phplyr\{arrange, desc, group_by, mean, n, round, sum, summarize};
```

```{php}
$orders = \Phibble\DataFrame::fromRows(\App\Data\Orders::generate());

$orders |>
    group_by('channel') |>
    summarize(
        orders: n(),
        revenue: round(sum('total'), 2),
        items: round(mean('items'), 2),
    ) |>
    arrange(desc('revenue'));
```
